note.text:
Some common hardware problems, their likely causes and simple solutions:
• The computer does not switch on: no power, loose cable, faulty power supply → check the socket, cables and power button.
• The screen is black but the computer is on: loose display cable, brightness at zero, faulty screen → check the cable and brightness.
• The computer overheats and switches off: dust in the fan, blocked vents → clean the fan, keep vents free, use on a hard surface.
• Keyboard or mouse does not work: unplugged, flat battery (wireless), dirt → reconnect, change batteries, clean.
• Strange noises: a failing hard disk or fan → back up data at once and ask a technician.
• The printer does not print: off, no paper, paper jam, no ink, not selected → check each.
Always start with the simplest checks (power, cables) before calling a technician.

worked_example.problem: A laptop becomes very hot and switches itself off when used on a bed. Why, and what should be done?
steps: The soft bed blocks the air vents, so the laptop overheats.
Use it on a hard, flat surface and clean the fan.
worked_example.answer: Blocked vents cause overheating; use it on a hard surface and clean the fan.
